questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
Select the option that correctly reports the statement: 'I am writing an email to my boss.'
options: He said he was writing an email to his boss.
He said he is writing an email to his boss.
He said he writes an email to his boss.
He said he will write an email to his boss.
questions.answer: He said he was writing an email to his boss.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information?
options: It is said that the meeting was postponed.
It is said that the meeting is postponed.
It is said that the meeting will be postponed.
It is said that the meeting has been postponed.
questions.answer: It is said that the meeting was postponed.

Select the correct collocation: He decided to ________ his career in finance.
Which option correctly uses a discourse marker to begin a sentence expressing contrast?
options: In conclusion, the results were disappointing.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition to complete the phrase: 'He was accused of ________ the company funds.'
Select the best word to complete the sentence: The report suggests that there is a strong ________ between stress and heart disease.
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been living here since 2010.
I will be living here since 2010.
questions.answer: I have been living here since 2010.
